correctness.rationale: The height fiber of K_d at x has length 2−||x||_1−||x||∞, and each integer dilation n contributes max(0,2n−||x||_1−||x||∞+1) lattice heights. Max-norm shell summation of F_m(u)=[(1+u−2u^{m+1})/(1−u)]^d produces the claimed rational A_d(u); selecting even powers from A_d(u)/(1−u)^2 proves the full Ehrhart series for every d≥1. For odd d, the potential u=i poles of the j≡3 (mod 4) summands cancel in the even extraction because the relevant ratio is i^{2d−j+1}=1. Independent rational SymPy reduction in d=4,5 reconstructs coprime denominators with cyclotomic factors orders (1,2,3,5) and (1,3,5), yielding exact minimal periods 30 and 15 by partial fractions and the pole-converse. Independent lattice enumeration at n=1 matches each rational-series coefficient. Order/sign chamber volume integration has determinant one and gives 2^{2d+1}/[(d+1)(d+1)!]. Finite checks do not substitute for the arbitrary-d shell and parity proof.
residual_risks: The general minimal period of K_d for other dimensions is not classified; only d=4/5 exact periods are asserted.
